name: Swarming Pillar
summary: Winged silithid circle Swarming Pillar, south of Cenarion Hold. Their swarm has carved and reshaped the rock into a hive in central Silithus.

sections.title: A Spire of Chitin and Sand
sections.body: In central Silithus, Swarming Pillar rises from the dunes, its natural rock carved into burrows and coated with the swarm’s resin. It lies just south of Cenarion Hold. From it, winged worker and soldier broods pour out in dark clouds that fill the desert air and warn travelers away.

sections.title: Heart of the Hive
sections.body: Swarming Pillar is only the visible tip of a vast underground network. Deep tunnels and cavernous breeding chambers beneath its stony exterior anchor one of the region’s largest hives. The Cenarion Circle watches with concern as active broods threaten its druidic operations and expose the coordination behind the silithid menace.

faq.answer: Swarming Pillar is a rock formation in central Silithus, overtaken and reshaped into an active silithid hive. Flying insectoids circle its peak in an endless swarm.

faq.q: Where is the Swarming Pillar located?
faq.answer: Swarming Pillar rises in the desert’s center, just south of Cenarion Hold.

faq.q: Why are there so many bugs flying around it?
faq.answer: Swarming Pillar houses one of Silithus’s primary hives, a massive nursery and transit point for winged silithid that patrol the surrounding sands.

faq.q: Is the Swarming Pillar connected to the hives beneath the sand?
faq.answer: Yes. The visible spire is the uppermost projection of an extensive colony, with tunnels carved deep into the bedrock and sands beneath Silithus.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see the hive at Swarming Pillar as an affront to the natural order. So close to Cenarion Hold, it remains a danger to the Cenarion Circle’s watch.
